turns.userMessage:
This is the official LEGO Halloween Ghost, loaded as-is. Build a black display pedestal (at least 6x6 studs, 3 bricks tall, one row of dark-grey trim) and put the ghost ON TOP of it. The engine cannot move placed parts, so to lift the ghost you must remove its parts and re-place the SAME arrangement higher up — record the original positions first (inspect_build), and rebuild it exactly, only translated. The final scene must contain the complete unchanged ghost (same parts, same colors, same relative arrangement) standing on the pedestal.
Constraints: use at least 30 parts.
